tracking_uid.title: Google Analytics tracking ID
tracking_uid.desc: To what Google Analytics property should the hits be sent to? The ID is usually in the form UA-XXXXXX-Y. You can find the ID in the GA's admin, in the Tracking Info section of the Property column.

scroll_tracking.title: Enable scroll tracking?
scroll_tracking.desc: Send events to Google Analytics based on the user scrolling activity on each page.

call_tracking.title: Enable call tracking?
call_tracking.desc: Send an event to Google Analytics every time a user clicks on a phone number.

form_tracking.title: Enable form tracking?
form_tracking.desc: Send an event to Google Analytics every time a user submits a form. For now it works only for forms made with the Gravity Forms plugin. The events are sent using the  measurement protocol with anonymized IPs; this means that the IP associated to the hit will be, for example, 77.123.456.000 instead of 77.123.456.789, and that ad blockers won't block the event.'

email_tracking.title: Enable email tracking?
email_tracking.desc: Send an event to Google Analytics every time a user clicks on an email address.

content_grouping.title: Enable content grouping?
content_grouping.desc: Group pageviews in Google Analytics using the Content Grouping feature.
